decisions.reason: As a 2024 product line with several models that builds directly on the firm's engineering, automation and plant-process know-how, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and is more likely to be improved than withdrawn despite earlier pruning of some 2023 robot variants.

Production analysis software is very close to the firm's existing controls, service and lifecycle-support capabilities, so the firm can readily learn from customer use and refine it commercially, making continuation more likely than exit.
